statement: Accepted-but-unviewed items remain eligible for the top slate no matter how old. Eligibility never expires; ranking competes on interest, not age.

statement: Accepted-but-unviewed items created while the reader was away remain in the full eligible set. Deterministic mechanics present that set without reserving a fixed promotion count; the runtime agent judges which items are valuable now.
evidence: Public feed ordering, arrangement, engagement, and retention tests.
verify_hint: Run feed ordering and arrangement tests against generic fixtures.

statement: Items repeatedly auto-promoted into the slate but never viewed decay in rank (promotion-count penalty) so the same stale set cannot monopolize carry-forward slots. They stay eligible.

statement: The hint-free runtime agent privately decides current value and freshness. Shipped primary rows persist that judgment in metadata.interest; deterministic heuristics may expose candidates or break ties but never substitute age, source, type, or volume for editorial judgment.

verify_hint: Run feed ordering and arrangement tests against generic fixtures.

statement: The slate interleaves curator thread blocks and carry-forward blocks by effective (durability-decayed) interest: a fresh batch item leads only when it genuinely outscores the unviewed backlog. Carry-forwards keep visible 'Still unread:' rationales.
evidence: Public feed ordering, arrangement, engagement, and retention tests.
verify_hint: Run feed ordering and arrangement tests against generic fixtures.

statement: Interestingness is judged AS IF FRESH (score 0-1) with explicit durability (evergreen/dated/news); ranking applies durability decay at display time. Time-sensitive commentary decays faster than durable mechanism or explanatory material.
evidence: Public feed ordering, arrangement, engagement, and retention tests.
verify_hint: Run feed ordering and arrangement tests against generic fixtures.

statement: A lone carry-forward never inherits a multi-item thread banner. Banners require at least two promoted members; singletons use a truthful shared or singleton lane.
evidence: Public feed ordering, arrangement, engagement, and retention tests.
verify_hint: Run feed ordering and arrangement tests against generic fixtures.

statement: Every agent-curated primary item carries metadata.interest. Agent-stamped judgment outranks bootstrap or fallback heuristics, and unjudged items remain visible to the runtime editor rather than silently becoming approved feed material.

statement: Each arrange clears all previous display orders and writes the new slate; if the curator skips arrange, feed sort falls back to created_at within 12h so stale orderings do not persist.

statement: New/pending posts merge through the feed ordering logic on reveal; they must not blind-prepend and wreck curated editorial order.

statement: The primary slate has a hard ceiling of 50 and no minimum output count. A smaller or empty slate is valid when it reflects the runtime agent's judgment; the editor never pads or fabricates material, and no mechanical volume-exception artifact is required.

statement: Deterministic curation mechanics present the full eligible candidate set and preserve truthful receipts. They never reject, approve, or upgrade completion based on item volume, source balance, item type, or thread count; the runtime agent decides what ships.

statement: No fixed source or item-type quota substitutes for editorial judgment. Prefer source diversity only when candidates are comparably valuable, and use the best source representation when multiple rows cover the same material.

statement: Every shipped primary item carries a stable shipment threadId through submission and arrangement. statement: Evogent and the stock Android launcher are peer home surfaces chosen explicitly by the user. MAIN+LAUNCHER chooses Evogent; the authenticated Android-home control chooses the stock launcher; MAIN+HOME follows the remembered choice without changing it. Ordinary app launches never change home intent, and a missing stock component fails safely back to Evogent.

statement: The configured Android assistant gesture opens Evogent's authenticated Add Message form without a persistent cross-app button. System-provided foreground context is accepted only for that explicit invocation, excludes password inputs and screenshots, is bounded, stays in process memory, and is consumable once. Lock-screen assistant launch remains disabled.

statement: Phone notification curation is local, lightweight, and reversible. Observe is the default; Curated shade changes only eligible ordinary originals after an exact durable event receipt, an active private Evogent digest, and a still-matching notification generation. Calls, alarms, navigation, ongoing services, high-importance, system/safety, secret, and group-summary originals remain Android-owned; known secrets are removed before loopback transport and storage, and no notification content is sent to a runtime agent.
evidence: Public phone-notification architecture, native policy tests, server curation tests, and accessible settings UI.
verify_hint: Run phone notification native/server tests, then exercise Observe, Curated, every exemption, failure preservation, stale replacement, and lock-screen preview on a physical Android device.

statement: Evogent must describe Android notification authority truthfully: NotificationListenerService observes after posting and can cancel many ordinary notifications, but it does not replace the lock screen, notification shade, At a Glance, media, call, alarm, authentication, emergency, or other System UI surfaces. Any unavailable server, permission, digest, receipt, ranking, or active-generation proof preserves the Android original.
evidence: Public phone-notification architecture, Android integration policy, and fail-safe tests.
verify_hint: Run notification failure-path tests and inspect both Evogent-owned and Android-owned lock-screen surfaces at the glass.

statement: A full phone cycle is a curation opportunity, not an all-source sweep. Each source runs only when its private evidence-backed cadence is due or a relevant source-specific signal overrides it; unrelated sources remain skipped, and failed or partial refreshes never advance cadence.
evidence: Public source-cadence mechanics, routing architecture, structured source outcomes, and phone control-plane tests.
verify_hint: Run generic cadence tests, then inspect a natural cycle and prove only due/signalled sources ran while a failed refresh remained due.

statement: Routine work uses the least expensive model and reasoning effort that passes representative production-shaped evaluation. Persistent cheaper routes require recent content-free paired baseline/candidate receipts with mechanics and quality passing independently; timeouts and device-driver failures never count as model-quality evidence, expired or insufficient proof falls back to the prior proven route, and one-run benchmark overrides never rewrite policy.
evidence: Public model-routing policy, grounded computer-use benchmark, receipt validator, provider invocation tests, and private natural-run verification.
verify_hint: Run model-routing tests, prove three paired passes, inject timeout/driver failures, inspect content-free receipts, and verify automatic fallback.

statement: At most one bounded high-reasoning private overseer reviews cross-cycle outcomes per service day. It may tune only reversible private cadence, routing, and preference synthesis; it never drives source apps, edits product code or committed instructions, or runs phone-side development. Product failures become directional host-review suggestions, and the overseer replaces rather than duplicates broad daily reflection/dream passes.
evidence: Public overseer instruction, durable scheduler task tests, private artifact postconditions, and natural daily-run verification.
verify_hint: Run the scheduler-owned overseer once, prove atomic private writes and a terminal receipt, confirm no overlapping reflection/dream run or app-driving activity, and inspect any host-review suggestion.

statement: Phone notification evidence Evogent accepts is curated only on the phone. Observe and Curated preserve every Android original by default. A cancellation request is permitted only for an ordinary event from a package the user explicitly placed on a reversible per-app replacement list; the UI and docs must call this best-effort because Android cancels by stable key rather than an atomic notification version. User-preserved apps and protected call, alarm, navigation, ongoing-service, high-importance, system/safety, secret, and group-summary events always remain Android-owned.
evidence: Public notification architecture, settings/API/UI contracts, native policy and lifecycle tests, and privacy gates.
verify_hint: Run notification server/native/contracts/privacy tests, then verify default preservation, per-app opt-in and revocation, protected-event preservation, and truthful key-only race wording with generic fixtures.
